title: Consumer Segmentation & Model Readiness Playbook for Market Entry
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Prepare a repeatable playbook to prioritize consumer segments for Redwood Inference market entry (SMB chatbots, productivity SaaS, and regulated enterprise verticals). The playbook will map buyer needs to model characteristics (latency tolerance, embedding quality, hallucination risk, quantization readiness) and recommend a readiness score and rollout plan for each segment.

Scope:
- Competitive signal harvesting for candidate open models and hosted providers relevant to each segment.
- Empirical microbenchmarks (latency, token cost, embedding recall) using representative prompts from segment archetypes.
- Business impact mapping: price sensitivity, latency SLOs, security/regulatory constraints.
- Decision rubric to convert signals into a one-page readiness score and a fallback strategy (model variant, quantization, Dedicated vs Hosted).

Out-of-scope for this ticket: full procurement negotiations and legal review for vendor contracts (handled by GTM/legal).
acceptance_criteria: A one-page playbook PDF (internal) that defines the readiness rubric and scoring for at least three target segments
A benchmarking workbook (CSV + sample prompts) with measured latency and cost for 4 candidate models per segment
List of recommended primary + fallback model variants per segment, with deployment mode recommendation (hosted/dedicated/private) and estimated unit cost delta
Stakeholder sign-off from Product, Solutions Engineering, and one Sales lead for each segment
tasks: Assemble segment archetypes and 6 representative prompt sets (PM + Solutions Eng)
Run microbenchmarks across shortlisted models and small/medium context lengths (Research/Infra)
Normalize metrics to per-utterance cost and 95th-percentile latency (Infra)
Draft readiness rubric and scoring thresholds (Product)
Synthesize playbook and one-page decision card (Design + Product)
Circulate for stakeholder review and capture sign-offs (PM)
Publish playbook, upload benchmark workbook, and link to dashboard (PM + Analytics)
Create follow-up Linear tickets for any model onboarding work flagged by readiness score

notes: Trade-offs: narrower segment focus accelerates deliverable but reduces immediate commercial coverage — recommended phased rollouts.

Risk: Regulated verticals may require Private deployment early, increasing TCO; include explicit escalation path in playbook.
